title: His father emigrated from Punjab to study at this college in 1946. In 2026, his son paid off its graduating class's loans.
sources: Fortune, May 2026 - NC State student loan debt paid off by Anil Kochhar
Indian Eagle TravelBeats, May 2026 - Anil Kochhar's gift for NC State University graduates
caption:
His father emigrated from Punjab to study at this college in 1946. In 2026, his son paid off its entire graduating class's loans.

At NC State's Wilson College of Textiles commencement on May 8, 2026, Anil Kochhar and his wife Marilyn surprised graduates by paying off the final-year loans of the whole 2025-26 class - 176 bachelor's and 26 master's recipients. Kochhar's father, Prakash Chand Kochhar, emigrated from Punjab, India to Raleigh in 1946 to study textile manufacturing at the same college, earning degrees there in 1950 and 1952. Anil Kochhar is co-founder and former vice chairman of Outcomes Health Information Solutions, a healthcare technology company.

Eighty years after his father arrived as a student, his son paid the debt off for 202 more.
